nodes.name: layout.tsx
nodes.summary: Next.js App Router root layout for the Masterminds Workshop site. Configures the Plus Jakarta Sans font, site-wide SEO metadata (title template, OpenGraph, Twitter cards, robots, canonical URL), injects the Meta Pixel tracking script, and renders the global dark-theme body with background particles, floating gradient orbs, the site header, page children, and footer.

nodes.name: RootLayout
nodes.summary: Default root layout component that wraps every page. Renders the html/body shell with the font variable, the afterInteractive Meta Pixel script, the PageParticles canvas, decorative gradient orbs, and the SiteHeader/children/SiteFooter stack.

nodes.name: PageParticles.tsx
nodes.summary: Client component rendering a full-screen fixed canvas with an animated particle field. Spawns 66 drifting particles, repels them from the cursor within a radius, and adds a trailing wake based on smoothed mouse velocity, redrawing each frame via requestAnimationFrame with resize/mousemove listeners cleaned up on unmount.

nodes.name: PageParticles
nodes.summary: Default export hook-driven component that sets up the canvas 2D context, particle physics, cursor repel/wake forces, and the requestAnimationFrame draw loop inside a useEffect, returning the canvas element and tearing down listeners and animation on cleanup.

nodes.name: SiteFooter.tsx
nodes.summary: Static site footer presenting Joe Che's bio with links to All Sorted AI and the Business Automation Mastermind, social icon links (Instagram, LinkedIn, TikTok) rendered as inline SVGs, and a copyright line.

nodes.name: SiteFooter
nodes.summary: Default export presentational footer component rendering the bio paragraph, three social media icon links, and the copyright notice within a glowing bordered footer container.

nodes.name: SiteHeader.tsx
nodes.summary: Client component rendering the fixed, blurred top navigation bar with the Masterminds HQ Workshop logo and brand wordmark. Hides itself on individual event detail routes (/events/[slug]) using the current pathname.

nodes.name: SiteHeader
nodes.summary: Default export header component that reads usePathname, returns null on event detail pages, and otherwise renders the fixed glass header with a home Link wrapping the logo image and brand text.
